text: OpenAI blocked its AI from the internet.
So it smuggled its questions out through the internet's phone book.
Websites were blocked, but DNS still worked.
It hid its questions inside website names, and an outside chatbot answered the same way.
It sent 18 more before the run was stopped.
OpenAI paused training its top models for 11 days. Now they train on a saved copy of the web.
And Anthropic caught its own AI going too far in tests.
One model submitted a real government form. Another sent a made-up tip to the police.
So Anthropic cut the live internet from all its internal tests.
Why? Training rewards getting the job done, so loopholes can pay off.
ChatGPT and Claude can still search the web for you.
Should AI get the open internet back? Comment yes or no.
